methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve high-search indoor countertop electric griddles spanning budget compact (Nostalgia MyMini) through premium (Zojirushi EA-DCC10, Broil King PCG-10), excluding outdoor gas flat-tops and panini-press-only appliances. Primary sources are official manufacturer product pages (gopresto.com, hamiltonbeach.com, store.zojirushi.com, bydash.com, bellakitchenware.com, blackanddecker.com, nostalgiaproducts.com, cuisinart.com, oster.com) and major retailers (Lowe's, Home Depot, Walmart, Amazon, Best Buy); secondary corroboration drawn from independent review sites (topelectricgriddles.com, bbqbarbecuegrill.com, foodal.com) and ManualsLib. Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-20 corrected three removable_plate over-claims (DASH base, BLACK+DECKER, BELLA — in each case only a temperature probe or grease cup is removable, the cooking surface is fixed/whole-body-immersible), corrected Secura wattage to the manual-stated 1700W (draft 1800W was an Amazon listing figure), and replaced a non-canonical Cuisinart source URL. Wattage and cooking surface are stated in whole units (watts and inches respectively); booleans reflect yes/no for the feature; null denotes genuinely unconfirmed data not estimated. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Presto 22-inch Electric Griddle with Removable Handles
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: gopresto.com confirms $69.99, 1500W (120V AC), PFAS-free ceramic nonstick, removable handles (cooking plate is NOT removable), fully immersible with heat control detached. Cooking surface 21.75x11.5 in (~253 sq in) per retailer listings. Max temperature not published by Presto (null).

products.name: Presto Tilt-n-Fold XL Electric Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: gopresto.com confirms $75.99, 1500W (120V AC), 254 sq in PFAS-free ceramic surface, tilt-n-fold grease-drain levers, fully immersible with heat control removed. Cooking plate not separately removable (whole-body immersible). Max temperature not listed by Presto (null).

products.name: Hamilton Beach 3-in-1 Grill/Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: Official Hamilton Beach 38546MN page confirms $79.99, 1400W, 180 sq in, max 425F, 2 reversible REMOVABLE PFAS-free ceramic plates, plates+drip tray dishwasher-safe (top rack), two independent temperature zones. 38546MN is the current variant of the discontinued 38546.

products.name: bella 10" x 20" Electric Griddle
products.priceNote: No MSRP published on bellakitchenware.com (shown as $--); retailers list approx $35
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: bellakitchenware.com confirms model 35112, 1500W, 10x20 in surface, EverGood ceramic nonstick (no PFAS/PFOA/PTFE/lead/cadmium), dishwasher-safe drip tray, REMOVABLE TEMPERATURE PROBE (the cooking plate itself is NOT removable — griddle is fully immersible whole after removing the probe). CORRECTED removable_plate true->false (draft conflated the removable probe with a removable plate). This standard SKU has no warming tray (a separate warming-tray variant exists). No MSRP on brand site -> priceUsd null.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Family Sized Electric Griddle
products.priceNote: No MSRP on brand site; street price approx $30-50 per retailers
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: blackanddecker.com confirms 20x11 in (marketed 200 sq in 8-serving area), max 400F, built-in warming tray, removable dishwasher-safe grease cup, and a REMOVABLE TEMPERATURE PROBE — but the cooking PLATE is fixed (brand page lists no removable plate). CORRECTED removable_plate true->false (draft over-claimed; only probe + grease cup are removable). Wattage 1500W per multiple retail listings (not on brand page). Coating type/PFOA status not stated by brand.

products.name: Cuisinart Griddler 5-in-1

specs.cooking_surface_in: 11 x 9 in plates (200 sq in total)

CORRECTED source URL from a non-canonical guessed path (/shopping/discontinued/grills/gr-4n/) to the live product URL. Functions as contact grill, panini press, full grill, full griddle, half grill/half griddle.

products.name: Zojirushi Gourmet Sizzler Electric Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: store.zojirushi.com confirms $184.99, 1350W (120V), 19x12.5 in cooking surface, 176-425F range, titanium-and-ceramic triple-layer nonstick. Body guard + cooking plate are fully immersible but NOT stated dishwasher safe (dishwasher_safe=false). Release year ~2013 per Amazon listing history (B00G2TVNCC).

products.name: Oster DuraCeramic Electric Griddle with Warming Tray
products.priceNote: Discontinued at major chains; street prices vary on secondary market
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: Lowe's listing confirms 1450W, 18x10 in. Independent review confirms DuraCeramic (PTFE/PFOA-free) coating, temperature scale 270-420F, pull-out warming drawer below, and a removable cooking tray that lifts out and is dishwasher/submersible. Model discontinued at major chains -> priceUsd null. CKSTGRFM18W-TECO is a titanium-infused sibling on oster.com.

products.name: DASH Everyday Nonstick Electric Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: bydash.com confirms DEG200, 1500W, 20x10.5 in, $49.99, PTFE (PFOA-free) nonstick. CORRECTED removable_plate true->false: the base DEG200 has a FIXED cooking plate; the removable-plate model is the separate Deluxe (DEG255). ManualsLib manual confirms 400F max dial. Dishwasher-safe status of the cooking surface not confirmed (null).

products.name: Nostalgia MyMini Personal Electric Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: nostalgiaproducts.com confirms MGD5OR, $26.99, 5x5 in cooking surface, nonstick. Lowe's confirms 550W. Fixed power-on operation (no adjustable thermostat). Max temp and dishwasher-safe status not published (null). Street price varies widely (~$14.99-$26.99).

products.name: Secura Smokeless Indoor Grill / Electric Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: CORRECTED wattage 1800->1700. Official ManualsLib manual (SM-1503GR/GR-1503XL), eBay and review listings all specify 1700W; 1800W in the draft was an inflated Amazon-title figure. Cooking surface 15.5x11.5 in (~180 sq in) per review. Reversible tri-ply removable grill/griddle plates with glass lid; plates + drip tray dishwasher safe. Max temperature not confirmed from a primary source (null). Price ~$70 street.

products.name: Broil King PCG-10 Professional Portable Nonstick Griddle
products.provenance: VERIFIED 2026-06-20: Independent review (bbqbarbecuegrill.com) confirms 21x12 in surface and max 400F (not 450F). PTFE/PFOA-free nonstick and full cooking-plate removability confirmed by reviews; removable backsplash and grease tray confirmed. Wattage not confirmed from any accessible primary source -> null. Price $175.66 observed at Amazon/bigkitchen.com.
